vulnerable.description: Upstream DataframeSerializer unchanged: the first rows of every dataframe (df.head()) are written into the prompt for the LLM. PandasAI v2's enforce_privacy option, which avoided this, was removed in v3 (commit c1429b32).

control.description: Repaired by the team: only the header row is serialized (df.head(0)); table name, column metadata and dimensions are still sent. One line changes. Protected against the tested row disclosure, not certified SAFE.

data_flow.source: Rows of the user's dataframe (dummy customer records in the harness).
data_flow.sink: Text serialized into the prompt sent to the external LLM provider.

validation.summary: A dataframe stand-in with schema metadata and dummy personal data. Column names appear in both serializations; the dummy email appears only in the vulnerable one.

assumptions: The dataframe contains personal or confidential data.
The LLM is an external provider.
limitations: No live LLM inference is run.
Without sample rows the generated code may be less accurate; this is the trade-off PandasAI v2 offered as enforce_privacy.
The schema description and column metadata can still contain sensitive text.
